tiles.textBody:
# 👋 Start here

Everything below is captured automatically (pageviews, clicks, sessions, and location), so this dashboard fills in from day one with no extra setup. The headline numbers will feel familiar; the retention and funnel tiles are where you point PostHog at your own events. Edit any tile, or duplicate the dashboard to make it your own.

## Are people coming back?

Active users show your trend; retention shows how many return after their first visit. The clearest sign your product is sticky.

## Where your visitors come from

The sites and channels sending people to your app.

## Turning visits into actions

A funnel from page view to click. Swap in your own events (signup, purchase, upgrade) to measure real conversion.

## What to do next

You've got the numbers. Watch how people actually behave, explore raw events, or dig into traffic and acquisition.

### How to use this dashboard

This dashboard enables you to analyze trends on your website landing pages. Including:

1. Unique session trends
2. The most popular landing pages
3. Referring domains
4. Pages per session
5. Average session duration
6. Where users are from
7. Device and browser type

To view data for a specific page, or group of pages, click on 'Add filter' and search for 'Current URL' to filter by URL parameters.

insight_10881555.name: Retention
insight_10881555.description: How many people come back week after week after their first visit. The clearest signal of whether your product is sticky.

insight_10881550.name: Active users (last 30 days)
insight_10881550.description: Unique people who used your app in the last 30 days. A quick pulse on your overall reach.

insight_10881554.name: Weekly active users (WAUs)
insight_10881554.description: Unique people who use your app each week. Smooths out daily noise to show the underlying trend.

insight_10881557.name: Visit to interaction funnel
insight_10881557.description: Of people who land on a page, how many go on to interact. Replace these steps with your own events to track real conversions.

insight_10892226.name: Growth accounting
insight_10892226.description: How many of your users are new, returning, resurrecting, or dormant each week.

insight_11251182.name: Core output mix by kind (weekly)
insight_11251182.description: What servers actually consume: prematch/postmatch vs reports, competitions, pairing.

insight_10892181.name: New & Returning Users
insight_10892181.description: Unique users broken down by new and returning

insight_10892223.name: Daily active users (DAUs)
insight_10892223.description: Shows the number of unique users that use your app every day.

insight_10892217.name: What devices do users access my product with?
insight_10892217.description: This chart shows which devices your unique users have been using over the past 30 days, so you can ensure you are designing your products and website for the right primary devices. You can get more detailed information by changing the 'Breakdown by' to 'Device ID'.

insight_10892212.name: How do most users access my product?
insight_10892212.description: This path shows the most 7 common paths taken by users over the last 30 days, starting at their initial pageview and proceeding for 5 steps. The size of a path reflects how common it is, while red areas reflect early drop-off. This can be especially useful for seeing where users get lost and understanding the most popular destinations.

insight_10892183.name: Unique Users on Landing Page(s)
insight_10892183.description: The number of unique users who visited a landing page compared to the previous period

insight_11251173.name: Install funnel: installed → first subscription → first output
insight_11251173.description: Per installation identity, 14-day conversion window, last 30 days. Activation is decided in minutes — watch step 2.

insight_11251184.name: Removals by activation state
insight_11251184.description: Was a lost guild ever activated? installed_only churn points at first-5-minutes friction.

insight_11251183.name: Installs vs removals (weekly)
insight_11251183.description: Net guild growth. Removals carry activation_state and tenure_bucket for drill-down.

insight_10892179.name: Most Popular Landing Pages
insight_10892179.description: Breakdown of most popular landing pages by unique sessions

insight_10892216.name: Where are my users experiencing frustration?
insight_10892216.description: This chart shows on which pages users have rageclicked the most in the last 30 days. This can be helpful for finding areas of your product where users experience significant frustration.

insight_10881553.name: Daily active users (DAUs)
insight_10881553.description: Unique people who use your app each day. Watch for steady growth or sudden drops.

insight_10892224.name: Weekly active users (WAUs)
insight_10892224.description: Shows the number of unique users that use your app every week.

insight_10892180.name: Referring Domains
insight_10892180.description: How users arrived on your landing pages broken down by referring domain

insight_10892220.name: Where are my users located?
insight_10892220.description: This chart shows where all pageviews for unique users originated from over the last 30 days.

insight_10892185.name: Pages Per Session
insight_10892185.description: How many pages users visit in each unique session.

insight_10892218.name: How do users find my product?
insight_10892218.description: This chart shows the referring domain for all pageviews by unique users in the last 30 days. This can be especially helpful for understanding how users find your product.

insight_10881552.name: Pageviews (last 7 days)
insight_10881552.description: Total pages viewed in the last 7 days, repeat views included. The classic traffic-volume number.

insight_10881556.name: Top referrers
insight_10881556.description: Which sites send you the most visitors, like search, social, and direct. Your acquisition channels at a glance.

insight_10892213.name: What screen size do users have?
insight_10892213.description: This chart shows what the most popular screen height is for unique users over the past 30 days. You can correlate this with screen width by changing the 'Breakdown by' option to specify 'Screen Width'.

insight_10892215.name: Which users are highly engaged?
insight_10892215.description: The GREEN section of this lifecycle chart shows identified users who completed a pageview in the last 30 days and in the previous 30 days, indicated strong engagement. By clicking through on each bar you can see a full list of the identified users, which is useful for arranging customer interviews or examining their sessions.

insight_10881551.name: Sessions (last 7 days)
insight_10881551.description: Distinct visits in the last 7 days. A session groups everything one person does in a single sitting.

insight_10892214.name: What languages do users prefer?
insight_10892214.description: This chart looks at the most popular languages among users over the last 30 days, identified by the language they've chosen for their browser. This can help you identify if you need to consider translating your product, or marketing to specific geographies.

insight_10892230.name: Website Unique Users (Total)
insight_10892230.description: Shows the number of unique users over the last 30 days.

insight_10892228.name: Pageview funnel, by browser
insight_10892228.description: This example funnel shows how many of your users have completed 3 page views, broken down by browser.

insight_11251185.name: Get Started CTA clicks by first-touch source (install proxy)
insight_11251185.description: CTA clicks broken down by first-touch utm_source. This is an install-intent proxy, not completed installs; a null source means no first-touch source was captured. Replace it after production emits guild_install_attributed and bot_install_completed.

insight_10892219.name: What browsers do users prefer?
insight_10892219.description: This chart tracks which browsers your unique users have been using over the last 30 days. It can be useful to correlate this with which devices users have been using, so you can ensure compatibility. Hover over a section to reveal what proportion of your users each browser represents.

insight_10892227.name: Referring domain (last 14 days)
insight_10892227.description: Shows the most common referring domains for your users over the past 14 days.

insight_11251174.name: Daily active guilds
insight_11251174.description: Unique guild_id receiving any core output (prematch, postmatch, reports, competitions) per day.
